_comment: Human judgement only. Everything else is derived by scripts/generate-manifest.py.
Keyed by stable id. Version bumps do NOT change the id, so entries survive them.
Edited via the tool's Settings page; AI drafts the values, a consultant approves.

entries.lldSummary: Enables the CIS Level 1 Attack Surface Reduction rule set in block mode, preventing common initial-access and execution techniques such as Office child-process creation, obfuscated script execution and credential theft from LSASS.
Enforces BitLocker full-disk encryption on the operating system volume with recovery keys escrowed to Entra ID, ensuring data at rest is protected and recoverable without local key storage.
Configures Windows LAPS to rotate the local administrator password automatically and back it up to Entra ID, removing shared local credentials as a lateral-movement path.

entries.notes: Reference only - description marks it DO NOT ASSIGN. Excluded from all blocks deliberately; retained for design comparison.

entries.lldSummary: Requires multi-factor authentication for all administrative role holders, with the break-glass accounts excluded, mitigating credential compromise of privileged identities.
